title: Line Integral over a Semicircular Path
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_C (x + y) ds where C is the upper semicircle x = cos(t), y = sin(t) for 0 <= t <= pi.

steps.title: Compute Arc Length Differential ds
steps.mathExpression: x'(t) = -\sin t, \quad y'(t) = \cos t \implies ds = \sqrt{(-\sin t)^2 + (\cos t)^2} \, dt = 1 \, dt
steps.explanation: Compute the speed along the unit circle.

steps.title: Substitute Parametrization into Integrand
steps.explanation: Evaluate trigonometric antiderivative at pi and 0.
